note: Shipped reference profile (workflow plane). A solo maintainer running the lifecycle with no governance plane and no external enforcement. Selectable as --profile workflow-only-profile. Validated by validate-reference-profiles.ts against the workflow profile contract; capabilities resolve against the agent-governance capability registry. This is a worked reference, not a test fixture.
scope: One maintainer taking a change from discovery to an accepted deliverable.
applicability: Single-owner project with no mandatory organizational policy.

topology.compositePresentation: Discover = Discovery; Plan = Planning; Review = Review + QA

requiredInputs: Each capability resolves its inputs from the selected provider's native reference.
publicationBoundaries: Each result publishes to the selected non-file provider; no shared serialized manifest.
exitRules: A capability exits when its result contract is satisfied and published.
completionEvidence: An accepted deliverable whose Review and QA results are preserved.
authorization: The maintainer authorizes their own acceptance.
freshness: Acceptance binds to the exact native revision reviewed.
failureBehavior: If the selected provider is unavailable, fail visibly; no silent file fallback.
absenceReport: No harness policy or external enforcement guarantee is claimed.
